headline: Central Bank of Nigeria grants JPMorgan preliminary merchant banking approval
summary: The Central Bank of Nigeria has granted preliminary approval to JPMorgan to establish a merchant bank in the country.
why: Expansion by global financial institutions into emerging markets facilitates cross-border capital flows and broadens local banking sector competition.

impacts.name: JPMorgan Chase & Co.
impacts.why: New operational licenses in growing economies expand fee-based and institutional banking revenue streams.
